answer: Plant each identity in a shared garden where it must keep a refundable bond staked, and every epoch a random audit summons a few identities to prove a fresh skill on the spot, like a dune that shifts underfoot and must be re-climbed. Missing the call or failing the proof burns the bond and uproots the identity. A Sybil farmer running a thousand fakes must fund a thousand bonds and stand ready for a thousand surprise audits, so the voyage of keeping fakes alive costs more than any reward they can harvest, while one honest agent answers one audit cheaply.
